info.name: Limble API V2 Assets Transactions API

params.name: billID
params.description: The ID of the bill for which an item needs to be added.

items.docs:
This request creates a Bill transaction by adding a Bill Item to an unclosed Bill.

Parameter: poItemID, Type: Int, Required?: Required, Description: The ID of the item that has to be added to the Bill.
Parameter: qtyReceived, Type: Int, Required?: Required, Description: The item quantity received on this Bill.

params.name: bills
params.description: This parameter is used to only get specific Bill Transactions by billID. This parameter expects a comma delimited list of billIDs.

params.name: items
params.description: This parameter is used to only get specific Bill Transactions by items in a Bill. This parameter expects a comma delimited list of poItem IDs.

params.name: start
params.description: This parameter is used to only get Bill Transactions that were created after or on the unix timestamp passed into it.

params.name: end
params.description: This parameter is used to only get Bill transactions that were created before or on the unix timestamp passed into it.

params.name: transactions
params.description: This parameter is used to only get specific Bill Transactions. This parameter expects a comma delimited list of transactionIDs.

params.name: limit
params.description: This parameter is a result limiter. The default is set to return no more than 100 results at one time.

params.name: locations
params.description: This parameter is used to only get Bill Transactions at a specific group of Locations. This parameter accepts a comma delimited list of Location IDs.

items.docs: This request gets information about the transactions made for a Bill.

params.name: billID
params.description: The ID of the Bill for which the transaction needs to be updated.

params.name: transactionID
params.description: The ID of the transaction which needs ot be updated.

params.name: transactionID
params.description: The ID of the Bill Transaction to be deleted.
